memory_high_mb.enforcement: Soft limit, triggers state compaction and background agent pause

memory_max_mb.enforcement: Hard ceiling, triggers emergency garbage collection and fast teardown

max_event_queue.enforcement: Bounded asyncio.Queue, drops oldest unhandled low-priority event on overflow

max_audio_command_seconds.enforcement: CommandRecorder strictly truncates capture at 30 seconds

audio_sample_rate_hz.enforcement: Hardware/software capture floor: 16 kHz 16-bit mono PCM

audio_command_max_bytes.enforcement: 30s * 16000 samples/s * 2 bytes = 960,000 bytes maximum STT audio payload

max_active_agents.enforcement: Single concurrent agent task runtime ceiling

max_steps_per_agent.enforcement: Agent loop terminates with failure if step count exceeds 30

max_api_calls_per_task.enforcement: Bounded LLM tool call budget per agent execution

default_agent_timeout_minutes.enforcement: Hard task cancellation if agent does not complete in 30 minutes

ai_timeout_seconds.enforcement: HTTP/gRPC transport timeout on model inference calls

max_browser_bridge_message_bytes.enforcement: Unix domain socket message frame upper bound = 1 MiB

dashboard_host.enforcement: Strict loopback bind only; no external network exposure

max_pending_approvals.enforcement: ApprovalBroker rejects additional requests when pending queue reaches 10
